GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Good night
   C. Thank you
   D. Good day / hello

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information, Interactive speaking.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.

8. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Buch
   B. Haus
   C. Schule
   D. Wasser
